name: InterContinental Hayman Island Resort
insider_take: This is Australia's most northerly island resort, where luxury meets the Great Barrier Reef in spectacular fashion.
whats_special: The resort sits on a private 400-hectare island in the heart of the Whitsundays, offering direct access to some of the world's most pristine coral reefs. It's the only resort on Hayman Island, making it an exclusive gateway to 74 tropical islands. The property features Australia's largest resort pool and has been a playground for celebrities and dignitaries since 1950.
pro_tip: Book the helicopter transfer from Hamilton Island Airport – the 10-minute scenic flight over the Coral Sea offers breathtaking aerial views of Heart Reef and Whitehaven Beach that you'll never forget.
dont_miss: Take a day trip to world-famous Whitehaven Beach with its 98% pure silica sand, or snorkel at Blue Pearl Bay where giant Maori wrasse and sea turtles are frequent visitors. The resort's private beach offers some of the best reef snorkeling directly from shore.
pros: Exclusive Great Barrier Reef access with world-class snorkeling, diving, and marine adventures steps from the resort
Pristine private beaches and resort pools set within a stunning Whitsundays island paradise
Exceptional personalized service befitting a true luxury island escape under the prestigious IHG Destined Program
Multiple acclaimed dining venues offering elevated cuisine with breathtaking ocean views
Luxurious and spacious accommodations featuring refined interiors and sweeping views of the Coral Sea
cons: Secluded island location requires seaplane or ferry transfer from the mainland, adding to travel time and cost
Ultra-luxury positioning comes with a premium price point across accommodations, dining, and activities
Adults-oriented atmosphere may not be ideal for families traveling with young children
